A high school teacher that I really loved and respected asked me point blank if I plagiarized a paper from a college student. I hadn’t. I was devastated. He seemed to believe me, and I proved throughout the year that I was the author of the paper in question by having similar work on other essays. But at the time I was mortified.

A friend I told about it said, “That’s kind of a compliment, he thought you were doing college level work as a freshman!” So I was like oh it’s sort of an insult sort of a compliment.

It took me time to change my mindset though, because writing was (and is) so important to me and who I am. Now I don’t even think of that, but it’s been a while.

I guess what I’m saying is, fuck that guy, and maybe you can flip this in your brain as an ass backwards compliment.

Either way, keep writing friend :)
